label: FICTIONAL and SYNTHETIC: Kestrel example, not real data

types.name: Password reset
types.risk_example: Low: customer stays locked out a little longer
types.reason: 99.8% accurate and a wrong call costs little

examples.message: I've forgotten my password and the reset email isn't arriving.
examples.proposed: Send a new reset link and ask them to check spam for an email from Gusta.
examples.rule: Resend the reset link once; point to the spam folder.

examples.message: Can you reset my password? I've lost access to my old work email.
examples.proposed: Explain that the account owner must change the login email first, and how to ask them.
examples.rule: Never change a login email without the account owner.
examples.verdict_reason: Did not change the email itself.

examples.message: Reset link says expired.
examples.proposed: Send a fresh link.
examples.rule: Expired link: send a new one and give the 30-minute limit.
examples.verdict_reason: Left out the 30-minute limit; the link expired again.

types.name: Can't log in
types.risk_example: Low: customer tries again or asks for a person
types.reason: 98.1% accurate and a wrong call costs little

examples.message: My 2-step code isn't arriving by text.
examples.proposed: Send the code by email instead and show how to update the phone number.
examples.rule: Offer email codes when text fails.

examples.message: It says my account is locked.
examples.proposed: Unlock after the 15-minute timeout and send a reset link.
examples.rule: Locked accounts unlock after 15 minutes; send a reset link.

examples.message: I can't log in on my phone but it works on my laptop.
examples.proposed: Ask them to clear the app cache.
examples.rule: Check the app version first; ask them to update if it's out of date.
examples.verdict_reason: Skipped the version check; the app needed an update.

types.name: Missing payslip
types.risk_example: Low: wrong month resent, employee asks again
types.reason: 99.4% accurate and a wrong call costs little

examples.message: One of my staff can't find her March payslip.
examples.proposed: Show where payslips sit under Employees > Documents and how to resend March.
examples.rule: Show the documents page and offer to resend.

examples.message: Where do employees download payslips?
examples.proposed: Link the employee app guide and the resend option.
examples.rule: Link the employee app guide.

examples.message: Payslip for last Friday isn't showing.
examples.proposed: Resend the payslip to the employee.
examples.rule: Check the run status before anything else.
examples.verdict_reason: The run was still in draft; there was no payslip to resend.

types.name: Update company address
types.risk_example: Medium: tax letters go to the old address
types.reason: 99.0% accurate and a wrong call is easy to fix

examples.message: We've moved office, how do I change our address?
examples.proposed: Update the registered address after confirming the account owner; tax letters follow in 1 to 2 weeks.
examples.rule: Only the account owner can change the registered address.

examples.message: Change our trading address to 14 Mill Lane.
examples.proposed: Update the trading address and leave the registered address as it is.
examples.rule: Trading and registered addresses are separate; change only the one asked for.

examples.message: Our address on payslips is wrong.
examples.proposed: Update the registered address.
examples.rule: Payslips show the trading address.
examples.verdict_reason: Changed the registered address, not the trading address.

types.name: Add a new employee
types.risk_example: Medium: employee set up on the wrong pay schedule
types.reason: 96.4% accurate: good, but not enough to send unchecked

examples.message: How do I add someone starting Monday?
examples.proposed: Walk through Add employee and the tax details needed before the first run.
examples.rule: List the tax details needed before the first payroll run.

examples.message: New starter is part time, 3 days a week.
examples.proposed: Set up a part-time contract with pro-rata salary.
examples.rule: Part-time staff get a pro-rata salary on their contract.

examples.message: Adding a weekly-paid worker to our monthly payroll.
examples.proposed: Add them to the monthly schedule.
examples.rule: Weekly-paid staff need a weekly pay schedule first.
examples.verdict_reason: Put a weekly worker on the monthly schedule.

types.name: Change bank details
types.risk_example: High: payroll paid from or to the wrong account
types.reason: 98.7% accurate, but a wrong call is costly, so a support agent checks

examples.message: We've switched banks, need to update the account payroll is paid from.
examples.proposed: Draft the change; ask for owner approval and a verification call before it takes effect.
examples.rule: Company bank changes need owner approval and a verification call.

examples.message: An employee gave me new bank details.
examples.proposed: Draft the update on the employee record and flag it to check against the signed form.
examples.rule: Employee bank changes must match a signed form.

examples.message: Change our company account number, urgent, payroll is tomorrow.
examples.proposed: Draft the change for tomorrow's run.
examples.rule: No bank changes within 3 working days of a payroll run without a manual check.

examples.message: You charged us twice this month.
examples.proposed: Confirm the duplicate charge and propose a refund of the second payment.
examples.rule: Refund duplicate charges in full once confirmed on the invoice.
examples.verdict_reason: Confirmed the duplicate, then refunded it.

examples.message: We cancelled in January but were billed in February.
examples.proposed: Propose a full refund for February.
examples.rule: Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing month.
examples.verdict_reason: February was still due; no refund owed.

examples.message: Can I get a refund for the unused months on our annual plan?
examples.proposed: Explain the annual plan terms and propose a pro-rata refund for a person to review.
examples.rule: Annual plans: pro-rata refunds only, reviewed by a person.
examples.verdict_reason: Sent it for review as the rule says.

examples.message: Payroll failed with a bank error.
examples.proposed: Point to the expired bank authorisation, show how to renew it, then rerun.
examples.rule: Bank errors: check the authorisation before rerunning.

examples.message: Run failed, says tax code missing for 2 employees.
examples.proposed: List the 2 employees and where to add their tax codes.
examples.rule: Fix missing tax codes before rerunning.

examples.message: Payroll didn't go through and staff are asking where their pay is.
examples.proposed: Tell them to rerun payroll.
examples.rule: Check whether payment was sent before any rerun.
examples.verdict_reason: Payment had gone; a rerun would pay staff twice.

types.name: Tax form question
types.risk_example: High: customer files a wrong figure and gets a penalty
types.reason: Costly if wrong and only 94% accurate

examples.message: Where do I find the year-end tax forms for my staff?
examples.proposed: Show Reports > Year end and how to send forms to employees.
examples.rule: Year-end forms live under Reports > Year end.

examples.message: Why is the tax on this form different from the payslips?
examples.proposed: Explain the form includes a correction made in November.
examples.rule: Check for corrections in the tax year before answering.

examples.message: Do I need to file anything for a contractor?
examples.proposed: Say contractors are filed the same way as employees.
examples.rule: Contractors use a separate form; never treat them as employees.
examples.verdict_reason: Gave the employee process for a contractor.

types.name: Cancel subscription
types.risk_example: High: account and payroll history closed by mistake
types.reason: 98.9% accurate, but a wrong call is costly, so a support agent checks

examples.message: We're closing the business, how do I cancel?
examples.proposed: Explain the final payroll steps and how to export records, then draft the cancellation.
examples.rule: Before cancelling: final payroll, export records, owner confirms.

examples.message: Cancel at the end of this month please.
examples.proposed: Draft the cancellation for the end of the month and list what to export first.
examples.rule: Cancellations take effect at the end of the billing month.

examples.message: Thinking of cancelling, what happens to our data?
examples.proposed: Explain records are deleted when the account closes.
examples.rule: Records are kept for 6 years after cancelling.
examples.verdict_reason: Records are kept for 6 years, not deleted.

types.name: Change pay date
types.risk_example: High: staff paid on the wrong day

examples.message: Can we pay staff on the 25th instead of the last day?
examples.proposed: Show how to change the pay date from next month and the bank cut-off.
examples.rule: Pay date changes apply from the next run; give the bank cut-off.

examples.message: Bank holiday on payday, can we pay a day early?
examples.proposed: Move this month's pay date one working day earlier.
examples.rule: Bank holidays: pay the working day before.

examples.message: Move this month's pay date to tomorrow.
examples.proposed: Move the pay date to tomorrow.
examples.rule: Pay dates can't move inside the 2-day bank cut-off.
examples.verdict_reason: Tomorrow was past the cut-off; staff would be paid late.

types.name: Invoice question
types.risk_example: Low: customer is confused about a charge
types.reason: 98.3% accurate and a wrong call costs little

examples.message: What is this extra charge on our invoice?
examples.proposed: Explain the charge is for 2 employees added mid-month.
examples.rule: Explain each line using the invoice breakdown.

examples.message: Can I get a copy of last month's invoice?
examples.proposed: Send the invoice and show where invoices are kept.
examples.rule: Invoices are under Settings > Billing.

examples.message: Why did our price go up?
examples.proposed: Say prices rose for all customers.
examples.rule: Check the customer's plan history before explaining a price change.
examples.verdict_reason: They had moved to a bigger plan.

examples.message: How is holiday pay worked out for part-time staff?
examples.proposed: Explain pro-rata holiday based on contracted days.
examples.rule: Part-time holiday is pro-rata to contracted days.

examples.message: An employee says her holiday pay is too low.
examples.proposed: Say the calculation was correct.
examples.rule: Holiday pay includes regular overtime.

examples.message: How do I record 2 days of leave?
examples.proposed: Show how to add leave on the employee's calendar.
examples.rule: Record leave on the employee calendar.

types.name: Export payroll report
types.reason: 98.5% accurate and a wrong call costs little

examples.message: Need a payroll summary for our accountant.
examples.proposed: Export the summary for the last tax year as a spreadsheet.
examples.rule: Default to the last full tax year unless asked.

examples.message: How do I export last quarter?
examples.proposed: Export Q2 using the date filter on Reports.
examples.rule: Last quarter means the most recent full quarter.
examples.verdict_reason: Exported Q2; the last full quarter was Q3.

examples.message: Can I get a list of all employees with salaries?
examples.proposed: Export the employee list with salaries.
examples.rule: Only admins can export salaries; this user is an admin.
examples.verdict_reason: Checked the user is an admin.

types.name: Pension deduction question
types.risk_example: Medium: wrong deduction explained to staff

examples.message: Why has pension been taken from a new starter?
examples.proposed: Explain automatic enrolment after the waiting period.
examples.rule: New starters are enrolled after the waiting period.

examples.message: An employee wants to opt out of the pension.
examples.proposed: Show how to record the opt-out and refund the first deduction.
examples.rule: Opt-outs within a month get the deduction refunded.

examples.message: Pension amount looks wrong this month.
examples.proposed: Say it was correct.
examples.rule: Check for salary changes before confirming a deduction.
